models.mechanism: The commanded definition now unfolds as a relational mechanism: ahad identifies a single absolute center, while al-samad depicts that same named center as the one intentionally resorted to and relied upon for needs. Oneness therefore becomes not only a count or abstract property but a convergence pattern in which many directed dependencies terminate at one referent.

activation_trace.literal_contribution: definition or essence stated as qawl
activation_trace.assigned_role: frames the paired predicates as a defining account
marks the unique endpoint of convergence

activation_trace.literal_contribution: intending and resorting to the relied-on one
activation_trace.assigned_role: supplies the directional relation from needs toward that endpoint

activation_trace.literal_contribution: Allah as a fixed divine name
activation_trace.assigned_role: repeated anchor joining the two clauses to one referent

structural_cues: Allah is repeated at the start of 112:2, re-anchoring the referent after Allah-ahad in 112:1.
The sequence Allah-ahad / Allah-al-samad pairs an absolute predicate with a definite functional title.
The second clause follows the first without introducing another agent, allowing the predicates to constrain one another.

abductive_moves.assumption: Resorting and reliance converge from multiple needs upon the one named referent, so samad makes ahad relational rather than merely numerical.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: ص م د B001 supplies resort and reliance, while ء ح د B001 and the repeated name supply one stable endpoint, but the many-to-one dependency pattern is not grammatically stated.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: Packet supplies absolute oneness, the relied-on/resorted-to branch, and repeated Allah; I infer arrows from unspecified need-bearers toward that single endpoint.
alternatives: Ahad and al-samad may remain two independent attributes.
Samad may emphasize solidity or endurance rather than resort.

changed_reading.before: The focus was a compact spoken definition whose content was chiefly absolute oneness.
changed_reading.after: The focus's ahad now describes the sole convergence point of reliance: oneness is enacted by all directed resort terminating in the same named center.

minimal_triggers: repetition of Allah across the paired clauses
models.ablation: Removing 112:2 or ص م د B001 erases the direction-of-reliance mechanism and returns ahad to generic absolute oneness; removing ahad leaves reliance without unique convergence.

models.mechanism: A material image emerges in which ahad is an undivided center whose compact, non-hollow solidity and tight closure prevent penetration or internal dispersal; enduring severity without depletion then makes that center fit to bear reliance. Solidity blocks breach, endurance preserves availability, and reliance is the resulting social function.

activation_trace.assigned_role: non-porous internal constitution that resists breach or division
boundary that closes entry and leakage
temporal preservation of the center's capacity

activation_trace.literal_contribution: the relied-on one to whom one resorts
activation_trace.assigned_role: functional outcome: a dependable destination for needs

structural_cues: Ahad is immediately followed in the next ayah by the definite al-samad, placing undivided oneness beside compactness and reliance.
The repeated name Allah identifies the solid/enduring image with the same referent as ahad.
Within the ص م د inventory, compactness, sealing, endurance, and resort form a material-to-functional sequence.

abductive_moves.assumption: A non-hollow, sealed, enduring constitution enables dependable refuge because it cannot be penetrated, dispersed, or depleted by what reaches it.
abductive_moves.why_invoked: The packet supplies solidity, sealing, endurance, and resort as separate branches, but does not state their causal ordering.
abductive_moves.causal_direction: Packet supplies ص م د B002/B003/B007 and B001; I infer solidity/sealing -> resistance to breach or loss -> endurance -> fitness for reliance.
alternatives: The material branches may be unrelated homonymous images rather than one mechanism.
Reliance may derive from authority, not material integrity.

changed_reading.before: Ahad primarily named absolute oneness in a spoken identification.
changed_reading.after: Ahad can provisionally evoke an undivided, non-porous center whose preserved integrity explains why it can function as refuge.

minimal_triggers: ص م د B002/B003/B007 linked to B001
models.ablation: Removing 112:2 collapses the material mechanism entirely; removing ص م د B002/B003 makes refuge generic, while removing B007 removes the preservation-through-time link.

surprise_reading: With al-samad, 'One' can describe a single destination toward which every need converges. More materially, it can evoke an undivided, sealed, non-hollow center whose endurance explains why reliance upon it does not exhaust or breach it.
discarded_or_unchanged: The stage-0 attribution-control model is unchanged by 112:2 and is therefore omitted.
